page.layout: One printed page, blank apart from show-through from the reverse side. No columns, notes or other blocks.
page.notes: The page carries no legible printed text of its own. The large lines near the top, the centred block in the middle and the lower lines are mirrored show-through from the other side of the leaf, so they are not transcribed. The round library stamp (Stadtbibliothek Zürich) is excluded. A faint pencilled mark sits at the right edge and is also excluded as handwriting. The page is treated as empty.
